text:
Ava (RevOps): Hey finance - quick ask. Vizion (large PLG customer) signed a 6mo pilot and wants to convert early to an annual commit. Sales is asking for a one-time credit on outstanding invoices to offset churn risk: INV-2026-0421 (~$42,300). Asking for a one-time 25% credit on that invoice + net-45 to net-30 payment terms. Can we get a quick decision so we can close this week?
Ben Ortiz: moving fast — can you dump the usage/ARR impact? Also tag any policy exceptions needed.
Ava (RevOps): summary in sheet: https://rwd.co/fin/vizion-convert (view only)
Ava (RevOps): current ARR from pilot ~ $190k ARR if they commit annual. Upside vs churn = ~$160k ARR.
Priya Rao: customer context: strategic analytics partner, referenceable in fintech vertical, TCV expected to rise if we keep them. They need shorter payment terms to onboard integrations quicker.
Priya Rao: sales prefers 12-mo 10% recurring discount vs big up-front credit — but customer pushed for invoice offset to smooth budget timing.
Ben Ortiz: rough math — one-time 25% on $42.3k = $10.6k credit. If they convert, LTV positive. But policy: credits >15% need director sign-off per deal desk.
Ava (RevOps): understood. Can we get provisional approval for up to 15% one-time credit and escalate to director for any above that?
Lina Chen: legal note — if we shorten payment terms to net-30 we need to confirm SOC/HIPAA data transfer addendum still applies; no change to DPA, but update invoicing clause. I can handle doc tweak if finance signs off.
deal-desk-bot: Policy excerpt: "One-time invoice credits <=15% may be approved by Finance Ops. Credits 16-25% require Deal Desk Director. Recurring discounts >10% require CFO approval." More: https://rwd.co/policy/credits
Ben Ortiz: OK. Finance provisional: approve up to 15% one-time credit on INV-2026-0421 and change to net-30 payment terms. For any request above 15% (e.g., 25%) we need Director review. Please add expected payment schedule and GL code when issuing credit.
Ava (RevOps): thanks Ben. Priya — will you confirm with customer whether they accept 15% one-time + net-30, or insist on 25%? I'll hold on the billing change until we get customer confirmation.
Priya Rao: pinged customer now. They asked for 25% in-thread but said flexible if we help with onboarding credits. Will update in ~2h.
Ben Ortiz: note for record: use GL code CR-OTH-2026, and tag this as "early-conversion-credit" for monthly reporting.
Lina Chen: once customer confirms, I'll prepare the amendment and the DPA note.
Ava (RevOps): cool. If they accept 15% I'll process credit and update invoice; if they push 25% I'll escalate to @Ben Ortiz and Director for sign-off.
Priya Rao: update — customer accepts 15% + net-30. asks for invoice adjustment by EOD.
Ava (RevOps): copying steps: 1) generate credit memo for INV-2026-0421 at 15% ($6,345) 2) change payment term to net-30 on renewal PO 3) record GL CR-OTH-2026 4) Lina will push amendment.
Ben Ortiz: confirm once credit memo created. Finance logs and approves retro GL entry. 
Ava (RevOps): credit memo created and applied — CM-2026-0897, amount $6,345. Updated invoice status sent to customer.
Ben Ortiz: verified receipt of CM-2026-0897 in ledger. All good from finance side. Approved and closed. :white_check_mark:
Lina Chen: amendment drafted and emailed for esignature.
Ava (RevOps): great team — closing thread. Moving to "deal-desk/closed" and tagging records. Thanks everyone :tada:
